notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 984d300e - Dissectors: Include what we use.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16748/diffs?diff_id=1084101818&start_sha=1e361b2fa5cf81a350741eea0f879e1b3ee8afa8)
Why the change to `array.h`? I guess you could argue the `g_ptr_array_len` uses ->len from `glib.h`, but I see no reason for the `stdlib.h`?
